judgment.reason: The premises entail that Ada wears an ivory badge. From p0, Ada wears either a violet belt or a copper ribbon (or both). If a violet belt, then by p18 Ada wears a violet card. If a copper ribbon, then by p28 Ada wears a violet card. Either way, Ada wears a violet card. From p1, a violet card implies a scarlet ribbon. From p13, a scarlet ribbon implies an ivory hat. From p14, an ivory hat implies an ivory badge. Therefore, Ada wears an ivory badge. The query denies this fact, so it is False.
